title: Machine Learning Modeling of Hospital Length of Stay After Breast Cancer Surgery: Comparison of Random Forest and Linear Regression Approaches.
summary: Retrospective single-center breast-surgery cohort n=198; RF/gradient boosting and linear regression predict LOS, with RF MAE 2.31 days, RMSE 2.82, R²=.37. Prolonged-LOS classification AUC only .545–.589.
